label: Whose context informs meaning?
explanation: The Contracts account addresses evidence of the parties’ agreement, including commercial practice and the governing jurisdiction’s treatment of extrinsic evidence. Katzmann addresses the institutional production of statutes and the value he attributes to legislative materials. Both require an explanation of why particular context bears on disputed language. Contract parol-evidence rules do not supply a test for using legislative history; the source, institutional setting, and competing interpretive theories differ.
